message:
**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Hello, I'm the Customs Border Agent Assistant, here to help document and analyze routine border inspections. Let's begin. What is the Inspection ID or Reference Number?

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

What is the date of the inspection? (Please use YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY format.)

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

At which port of entry or border crossing did this inspection take place?

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

What type of inspection was conducted? (e.g., primary screening, secondary inspection, agriculture inspection, cargo inspection)

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Was this inspection related to an individual traveler or a company/entity? Please provide the name and details.

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

What is the country of citizenship or origin of the traveler or shipment?

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

What was the stated purpose of entry? (e.g., tourism, business, import, transit, relocation)

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

What documents were presented for verification? (e.g., passport, visa, manifest, bill of lading, customs declaration)

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Were any customs declarations made? If so, please summarize what was declared.

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Were any goods, baggage, or cargo inspected? Provide a brief description and inspection outcome.

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Were any violations, undeclared items, or contraband found during the inspection?

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Was any enforcement action taken? (e.g., fine, seizure, denial of entry, referral to other agency)

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Do you have any remarks or observations from the inspecting officer?

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

What is the current status of the inspection case? (e.g., cleared, pending investigation, escalated)

**[CBP INSPECTION AI]**

Do you have any additional notes or relevant information for this inspection record?
